config.calls_convention: calls = scheduler steps x 48 layers (E5b: a request contributes 48 calls)
config.cost_mapping: nearest measured E5b bucket_aligned key (|dlog2 bucket|+|dlog2 batch|+1[alignment differs], ties to larger P); packed calls costed as batch-1 scans of the packed length; P, h, regret scaled by max(1,L/L_max)*max(1,b/b_max) beyond the measured range; histogram overheads from E4 at the nearest tensor size
config.time_scaling: arrival times multiplied by (prompt tokens * t_prefill_token)/(duration * rho) so that the offered prefill load is rho of 1/t_prefill_token
